name: python_exec
description: Execute Python code in a persistent namespace shared across all calls in this run. Variables, imports, and functions defined in one call are available in subsequent calls. Returns combined stdout + stderr (capped at 12 000 chars). Use this for all computation, data loading, analysis, and file generation.

name: write_file
description: Write text content to a file path, creating parent directories as needed. Path is relative to the current working directory (TASK_DIR) unless absolute. Use this to save JSON output files, scripts, intermediate results, or any deliverable.

name: read_file
description: Read and return the text contents of a file (up to 10 000 chars by default). Use this to inspect data files, check previously written outputs, or read instructions.

name: shell_exec
description: Run a shell command and return combined stdout + stderr (capped at 8 000 chars). Use for installing packages, listing files, checking environment, or running external programs. Default timeout 300s.
